probability_calibration.brier_definition: Mean sum of squared errors over 3 classes, range [0,2].

configuration.provenance: Benchmark moments are computed from existing local measured CSVs. Scenario mixtures, borderline distributions, quality shifts and measurement variation are modelling assumptions, not benchmark results or real fraud prevalence.

feature_generation_parameters.caveat: Truncated normals approximate benchmark moments; resulting moments differ after truncation. Joint KYC labels and cross-modality dependencies are assumptions. No benchmark is a joint KYC ground-truth dataset.

ablation_comparison.caveat: Conditional on this fitted pair and synthetic population; not real-world or training-seed uncertainty.

duplicate_diagnostics.near_duplicate_definition: All differences <= face .1, live .001, OCR .001, log1p(blur) .01, brightness .1, contrast .1

leakage_diagnostics.scaler_fit: Each CV training fold; final scaler on 7000 training rows only.
leakage_diagnostics.tuning: 5-fold stratified training CV only, both SVMs and tree.
leakage_diagnostics.calibration: Frozen estimators fitted on train; sigmoid calibrators fitted on 1500 validation rows only.
leakage_diagnostics.test: 1500 rows used only for final metrics, diagnostic importance, plots and paired uncertainty, never selection.
leakage_diagnostics.synthetic_label_limitation: Outcomes assigned by assumed scenarios, not real adjudication. Some scenarios intentionally have identical observable distributions under different latent outcomes.
leakage_diagnostics.benchmark_limitations: Local measurement files reused as distribution evidence, not independent real-world validation. Raw benchmark images not rerun in this experiment.

limitations: Synthetic joint distributions and adjudication labels are assumptions.
60/20/20 is an experimental allocation, not prevalence.
MIDV score is text agreement, not proof of document authenticity.
LFW and NUAA are limited benchmarks; no demographic, modern attack or device shift validation.
Calibration is for this synthetic population, not real-world certainty.
Clipping outside training extrema may conceal production distribution shift.
No online learning; explicit offline retraining needs confirmed real labels.
